name: optcatalog_blend_direction_toward_target
description: OptCatalog::BlendDirectionTowardTarget blends a direction vector toward a target direction with per-axis weights and normalizes the result.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent OptCatalog runtime source-cluster pass.
The normalized result relies on the accepted zMath::Vec3Normalize dependency.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4ae380 validates ECX as the in-place direction vector, EDX as the target direction, x/y/z weights as stack arguments, component updates as current + (target - current) * weight, a call to zMath::Vec3Normalize on the direction vector, discarded length return, and callee cleanup of the three weights.

The native OptCatalog smoke verifies weighted x/y blending with z held fixed and normalized to a 3-4-0 unit vector, plus the all-zero weight path that leaves a zero vector unchanged through normalization.
